# Release checklist

- [ ] Approved PRD/EDD/Test Design gates have evidence for the exact source commit.
- [ ] Required repository, Go, native/client, recovery, and packaging checks pass.
- [ ] Compatibility matrix states versions, measured scale, and limitations.
- [ ] Restore verifies data, identities/permissions/metadata, config, and key recovery.
- [ ] Upgrade/rollback/removal preserve operator data and configuration.
- [ ] Dependencies/licenses/notices, SBOM, provenance, and checksums are reviewed.
- [ ] Security reporting, supported-version policy, and operational runbooks work.
- [ ] Signed annotated tag and release notes are verified.
- [ ] Known limits and irreversible migration/pool-feature choices are explicit.
- [ ] Maintainer authorizes publication; no unresolved release blockers remain.
